icon:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: final production iOS application icon, one square PNG at exactly 1024 by 1024 pixels.
Primary request: Create a refined new logo for Daily Rhythm, a calm, encouraging habit tracker. Reference image is the existing app identity; retain its deep teal, sage mint, warm ivory and small coral accent, and the idea of a daily cycle plus one completed step. Improve optical balance and give it a distinctive premium geometric identity.
Input image role: brand/color reference, not a mockup to reproduce.
Design: A single bold, beautifully balanced open mint circular rhythm loop enclosing a compact warm-ivory rising check stroke; a small coral circular dot sits in the right-side opening as the next step. Smooth mathematically clean rounded ends, restrained geometry, excellent legibility at 32px. Calm and friendly. Flat vector-like shapes only.
Background: completely solid deep teal #142629 across the entire square edge to edge, fully opaque. No pre-rounded corners; iOS applies its own mask. Mark centered, occupies about 66% of the canvas, generous equal optical padding.
Colors: mint #82C9A6, ivory #F7F5E8, coral #FF9C7D, deep teal #142629.
Constraints: exactly one icon filling the image canvas. No letters, text, wordmark, caption, device, presentation board, shadows, texture, gradients, lighting, watermark, white frame or outside margin. Deliver the actual usable square icon, not a scene showing it.
launchSource:
Use case: logo-brand
Create one extremely clean transparent PNG logo asset, not a mockup. Reference is the Daily Rhythm app icon: preserve the exact overall geometry and placement of the mint circular open loop, central rising check mark, and coral dot. Render anew as pristine flat filled vector-like shapes, with absolutely smooth crisp anti-aliased contours and fully opaque shape interiors. Remove the dark square background completely: every area outside the three shapes, including the middle of the ring, must be true 0-alpha transparency. No loose pixels, no speckles, no wisps, no edge glow, no texture, no gradient. Change ONLY the central check mark color to solid dark teal #142629 so it reads on a cream/light background. Ring solid mint #82C9A6 and dot solid coral #FF9C7D. Retain the same square canvas, centered alignment and generous padding. No text or extra details. The entire asset consists of exactly three clean flat shapes on real alpha transparency.
note: Only selected opaque icon and clean dark-check alpha source are shipped. Native template rendering tints the launch mark with LaunchMark; discarded ivory-alpha generations are not production assets. sips performs only the required 1024x1024 app-icon size normalization.
